source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The folder popup formats labels synchronously with its dedicated folderWidgets Fluent Localization, so getDisplayName still returns a string immediately. The saved-search properties dialog instead reads verboseFolderFormat from its existing messenger.properties bundle. Removing folderWidgets.properties therefore does not mean that every consumer switched to Fluent. The current popup later adds path-mode and localized tooltip behavior; those are separate from this initial resource/receiver migration.
title: Folder popup Fluent labels and saved-search legacy names keep different localization receivers
